purpose: Turn sanitized outcome evidence into evaluated learning proposals without silently changing policy, skills, ranking, prices, campaigns, or production.
truth_rules: A single outcome never becomes a behavior rule automatically.
Missing baseline or provenance means HOLD/UNKNOWN, not improvement.
Correlation is not treated as causation.
Failed and rolled-back runs are learning evidence too.
A learning item may graduate only with explicit evaluation evidence.
Material policy/skill/price/publish behavior changes require Owner Gate.
graduation_rules: New automation learning is first persisted as testing with eval_required=true.
learned means evidence has passed evaluation; it is not automatically a material behavior change.
adopted requires graduation evidence and Owner Gate when the behavior is material.
behavior_rule remains null for a new candidate.
